plays.description: Adjusts to catch Wentz's deep pass; pushed out by Tyrique Stevenson.
Catches Wentz's third-down pass for a first down.
Steps up on third-and-six and throws incomplete toward Jefferson in the end zone; Thieneman is there.
Makes a 35-yard field goal to finish Minnesota's opening drive.
Recovers a fumbled snap and runs into Minnesota territory; caption cuts off before the result.
Escapes pressure, directs traffic, makes a defender miss and runs out inside the 35 for four yards.
Makes a 50-yard field goal after a high snap.
Snap from Blake Brandel goes through his hands on third-and-short; Wentz recovers at the 12.
Steps up against pressure and throws deep middle toward Luther Burden; Byron Murphy intercepts and returns minus one yard.
Protection picks up Chicago's blitz, but the pass toward Addison is incomplete.
Pass is not caught after Minnesota shows everyone at the line and drops some defenders; receiver and covering defender's names are garbled.
plays.coverage_scheme: all-at-line presentation with defenders dropping; exact scheme unknown

plays.description: Catches a pass for 16 yards and a first down with flags down; commentary says the penalty is against Chicago.
Runs for a first-down gain described as seven or eight yards.
Receives Wentz's third-and-long dump-off against pressure; T.J. Edwards trips him up short of a first down. Commentary says the tackle potentially saved a touchdown.
Makes a 49-yard field goal for a 6-3 lead.
Third-down play mentions a player transcribed as 'Marcus Freeman'; the action and result are cut off.
Catches a pass out of the backfield after Loveland motions away, loses his footing, gets up and reaches a first down.
plays.concept: pass to running back out of backfield
plays.personnel_formation: Loveland motions away; personnel grouping unknown

plays.description: With nothing open downfield, is hit while throwing an incompletion; Dallas Turner and Jalen Redmond close in.
Lowers his shoulder against Thieneman and gains eight yards to the 28.
Initially has time, but receivers are covered downfield and Austin Booker sacks him.
Dallas Turner reaches him and Andrew Van Ginkel finishes the sack near the end of the first half.
plays.defender_beaten: Dallas Turner; Andrew Van Ginkel (sack defenders)

plays.description: Runs for 13 yards near midfield on his first carry of the second half.
Waits for a receiver to come open, then runs for a first down.
Breaks free for a 15-yard run.
Finds room for 11 yards and a first down inside the 15.
Catches a first-down pass after Williams escapes Dallas Turner and extends the play.
Runs right tackle from the Minnesota 1 for no gain and fumbles. Jalen Redmond forces it; Isaiah Rodgers recovers for Minnesota.
Finds room through right tackle and crosses the 20 on a 20-yard gain to the Minnesota 24.
Goes down on a third-and-two pass play with a flag thrown; Odeyingbo is named. Penalty outcome is omitted.
Scrambles on third-and-five, spins away with Van Ginkel pursuing and gains a first down.
Is dropped by Metellus on a third-and-ten pass play with a flag down; penalty outcome is omitted.
Takes Wentz's dump-off with blockers ahead; T.J. Edwards tackles him one yard short of a first down.
Takes a short-left screen for 32 yards to the Minnesota 32, staying on his feet through the run.
Catches Williams's pass for 15 yards and a first down after a fake to Monangai and quarterback movement.
Runs straight ahead on third down, lowers his pads and is stopped one yard short.
Gets just enough on the ensuing fourth-down run to convert.
Keeps the ball on a boot after a fake; Van Ginkel trips him up. Williams is in pain afterward and Bagent replaces him.
Rolls out and dumps off a pass for one yard to the 5; receiver and tackler names are garbled.
Isaiah Rodgers blocks the 23-yard field goal off the edge; Chicago's T.Taylor recovers at the Minnesota 12.
Catches Wentz's pass against a blitz on third-and-five for 14 yards and a first down across the 30.
Catches a pass for a stated 20 yards into Chicago territory; initially called Josh Oliver before the commentator corrects himself.
Takes a flip from the 39 behind a Darrisaw block, reaches the secondary and is brought down inside the 25.
plays.concept: flip to running back; direction unknown

plays.description: Catches Wentz's pass and is driven back by Woods and Edwards, bringing up fourth down.
Makes a 39-yard field goal off the upright for a 9-3 lead.
Makes a juggling catch over the middle during Chicago's final possession.
Bagent steps up under pressure and completes a deep-right pass to Odunze for 21 yards; Odunze is pushed out at the Minnesota 20.
Dallas Turner finishes the final play against Chicago's quarterback; commentary indicates a game-ending sack but supplies no yardage.

offense_strengths: Jefferson supplied an early 30-yard reception and a later stated 16-yard first down.
Jones produced a 20-yard right-tackle run, an eight-yard run and a late advance behind Darrisaw's block.
Late passing conversions included Addison's 14-yard catch against a blitz and Hockenson's stated 20-yard reception.
Reichard made all three highlighted field goals, accounting for Minnesota's nine points.
defense_weaknesses: Williams repeatedly extended plays or scrambled for first downs, including a spin away from Van Ginkel and an escape from Turner before finding Raymond.
Chicago gained 13 yards with Swift and consecutive gains of 15 and 11 with Monangai on its opening second-half drive.
Chicago completed late passes to Burden over the middle and Odunze for 21 yards.

offense_strengths: Williams created gains with his feet and extended a play for a first-down completion to Raymond.
The second-half rushing sequence featured Swift's 13-yard gain and Monangai's 15- and 11-yard gains.
Swift generated a 32-yard screen gain; play-action also produced a stated 15-yard completion to Odunze.
Bagent's final possession included a juggling catch by Burden and a 21-yard completion to Odunze.
defense_weaknesses: Allowed Jefferson's early 30-yard reception and later 16-yard first down.
Allowed Jones's 20-yard right-tackle run after Chicago's goal-line turnover.
A late blitz conceded Addison's 14-yard third-down conversion, followed by Hockenson's stated 20-yard catch and Jones's advance inside the 25.

limitations: Captions only; no frames were viewed and no commands were run. The supplied DB is selective, so NO DB MATCH does not establish that a play did not happen. Partial plays at 02:19 and 03:15 have uncertain identities or outcomes; the isolated Swift mention at 01:02 does not describe enough action to identify another play. Names on unmatched plays are retained as heard rather than repaired from unrelated DB entries. No explicit personnel grouping or named man/zone coverage can be assigned confidently to an individual play; explicit motion and pressure descriptions are preserved. General references to pistol, man coverage and zone principles were not assigned to particular snaps. DB shotgun labels were not used for personnel_formation because that field requires explicit commentary. Defender entries include tacklers, pressure defenders and successful defenders, not necessarily players who were beaten. Interception yards represent the return; field-goal yards represent kick distance, and the blocked kick uses DB play yardage. Penalty dispositions and several play yardages are unavailable. The late Hockenson catch at 08:19 cannot be matched to the DB's Q3 4:01 Oliver reception for 24 yards: quarter context, stated yardage and corrected receiver differ. That Oliver reception, the listed kick returns and the 24-yard punt return are not identifiable in these captions.
